result.instructions: Tools for Givecloud, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find supporters matching this name and show their contact and consent status."; "Show this month's contributions and their donation totals."; "List recurring donations and their next billing dates.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Givecloud data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run givecloud_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run givecloud_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run givecloud_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. givecloud_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: givecloud_list_supporters
tools.title: Search supporters
tools.description: Read one page of supporters, with name/email and consent status. Addresses, payment details, custom fields and groups are omitted. Name and email are partial filters. GET /admin/api/v2/supporters.

tools.name: givecloud_list_contributions
tools.title: List contributions
tools.description: Read one page of contribution amounts, status, supporter identity and selected line items. Payment instruments, addresses, custom fields, comments and sponsored-child data are omitted. Date filters are exclusive and UTC. GET /admin/api/v3/contributions.

tools.name: givecloud_list_recurring_profiles
tools.title: List recurring donation profiles
tools.description: Read one page of recurring donation amounts, schedules, status and supporter identity. Payment instruments and addresses are omitted. GET /admin/api/v3/recurring-profiles.

tools.name: givecloud_list_products
tools.title: Search fundraising products
tools.description: Read one page of products, prices, goals and selected variants. code is exact; name is partial. GET /admin/api/v2/products.

tools.name: givecloud_list_posts
tools.title: List feed posts
tools.description: Read one page of posts in a known feed. Obtain the feed ID in Givecloud; this connector does not enumerate feeds. name is partial. GET /admin/api/v2/feeds/{feedId}/posts.

tools.name: givecloud_get_supporter
tools.title: Get a supporter
tools.description: Read one supporter by its Givecloud ID. Returns the same selected fields as the corresponding list tool.  No business data is changed.

tools.name: givecloud_get_contribution
tools.title: Get a contribution
tools.description: Read one contribution by its Givecloud ID. Returns the same selected fields as the corresponding list tool.  No business data is changed.

tools.name: givecloud_get_recurring_profile
tools.title: Get a recurring profile
tools.description: Read one recurring profile by its Givecloud ID. Returns the same selected fields as the corresponding list tool.  No business data is changed.

tools.name: givecloud_get_product
tools.title: Get a fundraising product
tools.description: Read one fundraising product by its Givecloud ID. Returns the same selected fields as the corresponding list tool.  No business data is changed.

tools.name: givecloud_get_post
tools.title: Get a feed post
tools.description: Read one feed post by its Givecloud ID. Returns the same selected fields as the corresponding list tool. A known feed_id is required. No business data is changed.
